title: Update: Incident involving the Gas Husky
body_markdown:
## [Update: Incident involving the Gas Husky](https://www.stealthgas.com/latest-news/455-update-incident-involving-the-gas-husky.html)


StealthGas Inc. (the “Company”) confirms that its LPG carrier Gas Husky was struck on November 17, 2026 while sailing in the Black Sea approximately 50 miles off the coast of Bulgaria. The vessel was carrying a cargo of LPG loaded in Alexandria, Egypt, and was heading to Midia, Romania for discharge.


The condition of the ship at this time remains unknown. It is further announced with great relief that all 19 crew members are safe after a rescue operation was conducted and they were delivered ashore. Our first priority is their welfare and are in close contact with them and their families. The Company extends its gratitude to the Bulgarian authorities involved in the emergency response and will provide further updates as confirmed information becomes available.
